title.label: Title
title.description: The title will be used within the tab button for this tab.

content.label: Body
content.description: Here you can define the content that will be placed within the current tab.

body_font.label: Body Font
body_font.description: Choose a custom font to use for the Body. All Google web fonts are available, or you can upload your own custom font files.

body_text_align.label: Body Text Alignment
body_text_align.description: Align the Body to the left, right, center or justify.

body_text_color.label: Body Text Color
body_text_color.description: Pick a color to be used for the Body text.

body_font_size.label: Body Text Size
body_font_size.description: Increase or decrease the size of the Body text.

body_letter_spacing.label: Body Letter Spacing
body_letter_spacing.description: Letter spacing adjusts the distance between each letter in the Body.

body_line_height.label: Body Line Height
body_line_height.description: Line height adjusts the distance between each line of the Body text. This becomes noticeable if the Body is long and wraps onto multiple lines.

body_text_shadow_style.label: Body Text Shadow
body_text_shadow_style.description: Pick a text shadow style to enable text shadow for this element. Once enabled, you will be able to customize your text shadow style further. To disable custom text shadow style, choose the None option.

body_text_shadow_horizontal_length.label: Body Text Shadow Horizontal Length
body_text_shadow_horizontal_length.description: Shadow's horizontal distance from the text. A negative value places the shadow to the left of the text.

body_text_shadow_vertical_length.label: Body Text Shadow Vertical Length
body_text_shadow_vertical_length.description: Shadow's vertical distance from the text. A negative value places the shadow above the text.

body_text_shadow_blur_strength.label: Body Text Shadow Blur Strength
body_text_shadow_blur_strength.description: The higher the value, the bigger the blur, the shadow becomes wider and lighter.

body_ul_type.label: Unordered List Style Type
body_ul_type.description: This setting adjusts the shape of the bullet point that begins each list item.

body_ul_position.label: Unordered List Style Position
body_ul_position.description: The bullet point that begins each list item can be placed either inside or outside the parent list wrapper. Placing list items inside will indent them further within the list.

body_ul_item_indent.label: Unordered List Item Indent
body_ul_item_indent.description: Increasing indentation will push list items further towards the center of the text content, giving the list more visible separation from the the rest of the text.

body_ol_type.label: Ordered List Style Type
body_ol_type.description: Here you can choose which types of characters are used to distinguish between each item in the ordered list.

body_ol_position.label: Ordered List Style Position
body_ol_position.description: The characters that begins each list item can be placed either inside or outside the parent list wrapper. Placing list items inside will indent them further within the list.

body_ol_item_indent.label: Ordered List Item Indent
body_ol_item_indent.description: Increasing indentation will push list items further towards the center of the text content, giving the list more visible separation from the the rest of the text.

body_quote_border_weight.label: Blockquote Border Weight
body_quote_border_weight.description: Block quotes are given a border to separate them from normal text. You can increase or decrease the size of that border using this setting.

body_quote_border_color.label: Blockquote Border Color
body_quote_border_color.description: Block quotes are given a border to separate them from normal text. Pick a color to use for that border.

background_color_gradient_repeat.label: Repeat Gradient
background_color_gradient_repeat.description: If enabled, defined gradient stops will be repeated until the outer boundary of the background is reached.

background_color_gradient_type.label: Gradient Type
background_color_gradient_type.description: Linear gradients radiate in a single direction across one axis. Radial gradients radiate from the center of the background in the shape of a circle.

background_color_gradient_direction.label: Gradient Direction
background_color_gradient_direction.description: Change the direction of the gradient by choosing a starting position within a 360 degree range.

background_color_gradient_direction_radi.label: Gradient Position
background_color_gradient_direction_radi.description: Change the direction of the gradient by choosing a starting position within a 360 degree range.

background_color_gradient_stops.label: Gradient Stops
background_color_gradient_stops.description: Add two or more color stops to your gradient background. Each stop can be dragged to any position on the gradient bar. From each color stop to the next the color is interpolated into a smooth gradient.

background_color_gradient_unit.label: Gradient Unit
background_color_gradient_unit.description: Define the units of your gradient stop positions.

background_color_gradient_overlays_image.label: Place Gradient Above Background Image
background_color_gradient_overlays_image.description: If enabled, gradient will be positioned on top of background-image

background_color_gradient_start_position.label: Start Position
background_color_gradient_start_position.description: By adjusting the starting position of the gradient, you can control how quickly or slowly each color transitions, and where the transition begins.

background_color_gradient_end_position.label: End Position
background_color_gradient_end_position.description: By adjusting the ending position of the gradient, you can control how quickly or slowly each color transitions, and where the transition begins.

parallax.label: Use Parallax Effect
parallax.description: If enabled, your background image will stay fixed as your scroll, creating a fun parallax-like effect.

parallax_method.label: Parallax Method
parallax_method.description: Define the method, used for the parallax effect.

background_size.label: Background Image Size
background_size.description: Choosing "Cover" will force the image to fill the entire background area, clipping the image when necessary. Choosing "Fit" will ensure that the entire image is always visible, but can result in blank spaces around the image. When set to "Actual Size," the image will not be resized at all.

background_position.label: Background Image Position
background_position.description: Choose where you would like the background image to be positioned within this element. You may want to position the background based on the the image's focus point.

background_repeat.label: Background Image Repeat
background_repeat.description: If the background image is smaller than the size of the element, you may want the image to repeat. This result will result in a background image pattern.

background_blend.label: Background Image Blend
background_blend.description: Background images can be blended with the background color, merging the two and creating unique effects.

background_video_mp4.label: Background Video MP4
background_video_mp4.description: All videos should be uploaded in both .MP4 .WEBM formats to ensure maximum compatibility in all browsers. Upload the .MP4 version here.
background_video_mp4.choose_text: Choose a Background Video MP4 File

background_video_webm.label: Background Video Webm
background_video_webm.description: All videos should be uploaded in both .MP4 .WEBM formats to ensure maximum compatibility in all browsers. Upload the .WEBM version here.
background_video_webm.choose_text: Choose a Background Video WEBM File

background_video_width.label: Background Video Width
background_video_width.description: In order for videos to be sized correctly, you must input the exact width (in pixels) of your video here.

background_video_height.label: Background Video Height
background_video_height.description: In order for videos to be sized correctly, you must input the exact height (in pixels) of your video here.

allow_player_pause.label: Pause Video When Another Video Plays
allow_player_pause.description: Allow video to be paused by other players when they begin playing

background_video_pause_outside_viewport.label: Pause Video While Not In View
background_video_pause_outside_viewport.description: Allow video to be paused while it is not in the visible area.

transform_styles.label: Transform
transform_styles.description: Using the transform controls, you can performance visual adjustments to any element using a combination of Scale, Translation, Rotation and Skew settings. This allows you to create advanced design effects without the need of a separate graphic design program.

positioning.label: Position
positioning.description: Here you can choose the element's position type. Absolutlely positioned elements will float inside their parent elements. Fixed positioned elements will float within the browser viewport. Relatively positioned elements sit statically in their parent container, but can still be offset without disrupting surrounding elements.

position_origin_a.label: Location
position_origin_a.description: Here you can adjust the element's starting location within its parent container. You can further adjust the element's position using the offset controls.

position_origin_f.label: Location
position_origin_f.description: Here you can adjust the element's starting location within its parent container. You can further adjust the element's position using the offset controls.

position_origin_r.label: Offset Origin
position_origin_r.description: Here you can choose from which corner this element is offset from. The vertical and horizontal offset adjustments will be affected based on the element's offset origin.

vertical_offset.label: Vertical Offset
vertical_offset.description: Here you can adjust the element's position upwards or downwards from its starting location, which may differ based on its offset origin.

horizontal_offset.label: Horizontal Offset
horizontal_offset.description: Here you can adjust the element's position left or right from its starting location, which may differ based on its offset origin.

z_index.label: Z Index
z_index.description: Here you can control element position on the z axis. Elements with higher z-index values will sit atop elements with lower z-index values.

overflow-x.label: Horizontal Overflow
overflow-x.description: Here you can control element overflow on the X axis. If set to scroll, content that overflows static widths or heights will trigger a browser scrollbar. If set to hidden, content overflow will be clipped.

overflow-y.label: Vertical Overflow
overflow-y.description: Here you can control element overflow on the Y axis. If set to scroll, content that overflows static widths or heights will trigger a browser scrollbar. If set to hidden, content overflow will be clipped.

display_conditions.label: Display Conditions
display_conditions.description: Choose when to display this element based on a set of conditions. Multiple conditions can be added. Date & Time condition is based on your timezone settings in your WordPress General Settings

custom_padding.label: Padding
custom_padding.description: Padding adds extra space to the inside of the element, increasing the distance between the edge of the element and its inner contents.

filter_hue_rotate.label: Hue
filter_hue_rotate.description: Shift all colors by this amount.

filter_saturate.label: Saturation
filter_saturate.description: Define how intense the color saturation should be.

filter_brightness.label: Brightness
filter_brightness.description: Define how bright the colors should be.

filter_contrast.label: Contrast
filter_contrast.description: Define how distinct bright and dark areas should be.

filter_invert.label: Invert
filter_invert.description: Invert the hue, saturation, and brightness by this amount.

filter_sepia.label: Sepia
filter_sepia.description: Travel back in time by this amount.

filter_opacity.label: Opacity
filter_opacity.description: Define how transparent or opaque this should be.

mix_blend_mode.label: Blend Mode
mix_blend_mode.description: Modify how this element blends with any layers beneath it. To reset, choose the "Normal" option.

hover_transition_duration.label: Transition Duration
hover_transition_duration.description: This controls the transition duration of the hover animation.

hover_transition_delay.label: Transition Delay
hover_transition_delay.description: This controls the transition delay of the hover animation.

hover_transition_speed_curve.label: Transition Speed Curve
hover_transition_speed_curve.description: This controls the transition speed curve of the hover animation.

link_option_url.label: Module Link URL
link_option_url.description: When clicked the module will link to this URL.

link_option_url_new_window.label: Module Link Target
link_option_url_new_window.description: Here you can choose whether or not your link opens in a new window
